1: ## Process lifecycle
2: 
3: - Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
4: - Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
5: - After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.
6: 
7: ## Linux browser and WebGPU capture
8: 
9: - Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
10: - Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
11: - Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
12: - Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
13: - Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
14: - Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
15: - Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
16: - Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
17: - Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

## Objective
- Finish the existing Eldoria dark-fantasy action RPG as a complete, playable game.

## Requirements
- Build the game now without clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finishing.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots (viewport at most 1280px wide) and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected the project structure and existing game implementation.

### Active
- Finish wiring and implementing gameplay, UI interactions, and a complete playable game loop.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect the remaining `src/main.js` and related game modules to identify unfinished functionality.
2. Implement and connect the missing gameplay/UI systems.
3. Run the game and verify it in-browser; capture and inspect a latest small JPEG screenshot.
4. Summarize completed work and any assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game screens, HUD, panels, controls, dialogue, and overlays.
- `src/main.js`: Game UI and main game orchestration; only lines 1–43 have been inspected.
- `src/world.js`: World generation, rendering, enemy AI, projectiles, and effects.
- `src/combat.js`: Attacks, skills, damage, loot rewards, and combat updates.
- `src/player.js`: Player creation and movement.
- `src/progression.js`: Leveling logic.
- `src/inventory.js`: Equipment, loot, and stat recalculation.
- `src/data.js`: Classes, enemies, quests, items, and regions.
- `src/save.js`: Local save/load support.
- `styles.css`: Game visuals and responsive UI.

## Important Context
- The game already has an extensive HTML/CSS interface and modular gameplay systems, but the inspected work has not yet changed any files.
- `src/main.js` inspection stopped at line 43; its input handling, initialization, and animation loop remain to be examined.

## Objective
- Complete the existing Eldoria dark-fantasy action RPG as a playable game, continuing from the unfinished codebase.

## Requirements
- Build without clarification; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finishing.
- For visual checks, save a small JPEG screenshot (viewport at most 1280px wide) and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected the project structure, game UI, gameplay modules, and current `src/main.js` contents.
- Confirmed `src/main.js` currently ends after the `GameUI` class at line 43; the main orchestration, event wiring, initialization, and animation loop are absent.

### Active
- Implement and connect the game loop, UI interactions, and playable progression using the existing systems.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Implement initialization, menu/class selection, save/load, input bindings, HUD abilities, and the animation loop in `src/main.js`.
2. Connect existing combat, movement, inventory, quest, pause/death, and dialogue systems into a complete gameplay loop.
3. Run and verify the game in-browser; capture and inspect the latest small JPEG screenshot.
4. Summarize completed work and briefly note assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: UI exists but orchestration and gameplay bootstrapping are missing.
- `index.html`: Menu, character selection, HUD, panels, and overlays.
- `src/world.js`: World rendering, enemies, drops, projectiles, and AI.
- `src/combat.js`: Attacks, skills, damage, loot rewards, and combat updates.
- `src/player.js`: Player creation and movement.
- `src/inventory.js`: Equipment, loot, and stat recalculation.
- `src/progression.js`: Leveling logic.
- `src/data.js`: Classes, enemies, quests, items, and regions.
- `src/save.js`: Local save/load support.
- `styles.css`: Game visuals and responsive UI.

## Important Context
- No files have been changed yet.
- `GameUI` in `src/main.js` already implements screen/panel rendering, HUD updates, quest interactions, minimap, and damage numbers, but no code instantiates it or starts the game.
- `World.update()` updates camera, projectiles, drops, and enemy AI; `World.draw()` renders the scene.

## Objective
- Complete the existing Eldoria dark-fantasy action RPG as a playable game, continuing from the unfinished codebase.

## Requirements
- Build without clarification; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finishing.
- For visual checks, save a small JPEG screenshot (viewport at most 1280px wide) and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected the project structure, UI, gameplay modules, and `src/main.js`.
- Confirmed `src/main.js` ends after the `GameUI` class; orchestration, event wiring, initialization, and animation loop are absent.
- Reviewed the HTML controls and existing world, combat, inventory, progression, save, player, and game data APIs.

### Active
- Implement and connect the game loop, UI interactions, and playable progression in `src/main.js`.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add initialization, menu/class selection, save/load, input bindings, HUD abilities, and the animation loop.
2. Connect combat, movement, inventory, quest, pause/death, and dialogue systems into the gameplay loop.
3. Run and verify the game in-browser; capture and inspect the latest small JPEG screenshot.
4. Summarize completed work and briefly note assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: UI exists but orchestration and gameplay bootstrapping are missing.
- `index.html`: Menu, character selection, HUD, panels, and overlays.
- `src/world.js`: World rendering, enemies, drops, projectiles, and AI.
- `src/combat.js`: Attacks, skills, damage, loot rewards, and combat updates.
- `src/player.js`: Player creation and movement.
- `src/inventory.js`: Equipment, loot, and stat recalculation.
- `src/progression.js`: Leveling logic.
- `src/data.js`: Classes, enemies, quests, items, and regions.
- `src/save.js`: Local save/load support.
- `styles.css`: Game visuals and responsive UI.

## Important Context
- No files have been changed.
- `GameUI` in `src/main.js` implements screens/panels, HUD updates, quest interactions, minimap, and damage numbers, but no code instantiates it or starts the game.
- `World.update()` updates camera, projectiles, drops, and enemy AI; `World.draw()` renders the scene.

## Objective
- Complete Eldoria as a playable dark-fantasy action RPG by connecting its existing systems and adding game startup and progression.

## Requirements
- Build without clarification; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finishing.
- For visual checks, save a small JPEG screenshot with a viewport no wider than 1280px and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected `src/main.js`, game modules, `index.html`, and the project scripts.
- Confirmed `src/main.js` currently ends after `GameUI`; no orchestration, event wiring, initialization, or animation loop exists.

### Active
- Implement and connect the game loop, UI interactions, and playable progression in `src/main.js`.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add initialization, menu/class selection, save/load, input bindings, HUD abilities, and the animation loop.
2. Connect combat, movement, inventory, quests, pause/death, and dialogue to gameplay.
3. Run and verify the game in-browser; capture and inspect the latest small JPEG screenshot.
4. Summarize completed work and briefly note assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Existing UI and the missing gameplay orchestration.
- `index.html`: Menus, character selection, HUD, panels, and overlays.
- `src/world.js`: World rendering, enemies, drops, projectiles, and AI.
- `src/combat.js`: Attacks, skills, damage, loot rewards, and combat updates.
- `src/player.js`: Player creation and movement.
- `src/inventory.js`: Equipment, loot, and stat recalculation.
- `src/progression.js`: Leveling logic.
- `src/data.js`: Classes, enemies, quests, items, and regions.
- `src/save.js`: Local save/load support.
- `styles.css`: Game visuals and responsive UI.

## Important Context
- No files have been changed.
- `GameUI` already implements screen and panel rendering, HUD updates, quest interactions, minimap, and damage numbers, but nothing instantiates it or starts the game.
- `World.update()` updates camera, projectiles, drops, and enemy AI; `World.draw()` renders the scene.

## Objective
- Complete Eldoria as a playable dark-fantasy action RPG by connecting existing systems and adding game startup and progression.

## Requirements
- Build without clarification; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finishing.
- For visual checks, save a small JPEG screenshot with a viewport no wider than 1280px and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected existing UI, game modules, HTML, and startup scripts; confirmed gameplay orchestration and initialization are absent.
- Identified existing `GameUI` features and game systems available to connect.

### Active
- Implement and connect the game loop, UI interactions, and playable progression, primarily in `src/main.js`.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add initialization, character selection, save/load, input bindings, HUD abilities, and the animation loop.
2. Connect combat, movement, inventory, quests, pause/death, and dialogue to gameplay.
3. Run and verify the game in-browser; capture and inspect the latest small JPEG screenshot.
4. Summarize completed work and briefly note assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Existing UI; missing gameplay orchestration and initialization.
- `index.html`: Menus, character selection, HUD, panels, and overlays.
- `src/world.js`: World rendering, enemies, drops, projectiles, and AI.
- `src/combat.js`: Attacks, skills, damage, loot rewards, and combat updates.
- `src/player.js`: Player creation and movement.
- `src/inventory.js`: Equipment, loot, and stat recalculation.
- `src/progression.js`: Leveling logic.
- `src/data.js`: Classes, enemies, quests, items, and regions.
- `src/save.js`: Local save/load support.
- `styles.css`: Game visuals and responsive UI.
- `start.sh`, `capture.sh`: Project startup and screenshot scripts.

## Important Context
- No files have been changed.
- `GameUI` already implements screen and panel rendering, HUD updates, quest interactions, minimap, and damage numbers, but nothing instantiates it or starts the game.
- `World.update()` updates camera, projectiles, drops, and enemy AI; `World.draw()` renders the scene.

## Objective
- Complete Eldoria as a playable dark-fantasy action RPG by connecting existing systems and adding game startup and progression.

## Requirements
- Build without clarification; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finishing.
- For visual checks, save a small JPEG screenshot with a viewport no wider than 1280px and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected `GameUI`, game modules, HTML, and startup scripts; confirmed gameplay orchestration and initialization are absent.
- Identified existing UI features and systems available to connect.

### Active
- Implement and connect the game loop, UI interactions, and playable progression, primarily in `src/main.js`.
- Verify the game in-browser and capture and inspect the latest small JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add initialization, character selection, save/load, input bindings, HUD abilities, and the animation loop.
2. Connect combat, movement, inventory, quests, pause/death, and dialogue to gameplay.
3. Run and verify the game in-browser; capture and inspect the latest small JPEG screenshot.
4. Summarize completed work and briefly note assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Existing UI; missing gameplay orchestration and initialization.
- `index.html`: Menus, character selection, HUD, panels, and overlays.
- `src/world.js`: World rendering, enemies, drops, projectiles, and AI.
- `src/combat.js`: Attacks, skills, damage, loot rewards, and combat updates.
- `src/player.js`: Player creation and movement.
- `src/inventory.js`: Equipment, loot, and stat recalculation.
- `src/progression.js`: Leveling logic.
- `src/data.js`: Classes, enemies, quests, items, and regions.
- `src/save.js`: Local save/load support.
- `styles.css`: Game visuals and responsive UI.
- `start.sh`, `capture.sh`: Project startup and screenshot scripts.

## Important Context
- No files have been changed.
- `GameUI` already implements screen and panel rendering, HUD updates, quest interactions, minimap, and damage numbers, but nothing instantiates it or starts the game.
- `World.update()` updates camera, projectiles, drops, and enemy AI; `World.draw()` renders the scene.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete Eldoria as a playable dark-fantasy action RPG by connecting existing systems and adding game startup and progression.

## Requirements
- Build without clarification; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finishing.
- For visual checks, save a small JPEG screenshot with a viewport no wider than 1280px and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- No implementation decisions made yet.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected the game UI, gameplay modules, HTML, and startup scripts; confirmed gameplay orchestration and initialization are absent.
- Identified existing UI features and systems available to connect.

### Active
- Implement and connect the game loop, UI interactions, and playable progression, primarily in `src/main.js`.
- Verify the game in-browser and capture and inspect the latest small JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- None.

## Next Move
1. Add initialization, character selection, save/load, input bindings, HUD abilities, and the animation loop.
2. Connect combat, movement, inventory, quests, pause/death, and dialogue to gameplay.
3. Run and verify the game in-browser; capture and inspect the latest small JPEG screenshot.
4. Summarize completed work and briefly note assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Existing UI; missing gameplay orchestration and initialization.
- `index.html`: Menus, character selection, HUD, panels, and overlays.
- `src/world.js`: World rendering, enemies, drops, projectiles, and AI.
- `src/combat.js`: Attacks, skills, damage, loot rewards, and combat updates.
- `src/player.js`: Player creation and movement.
- `src/inventory.js`: Equipment, loot, and stat recalculation.
- `src/progression.js`: Leveling logic.
- `src/data.js`: Classes, enemies, quests, items, and regions.
- `src/save.js`: Local save/load support.
- `styles.css`: Game visuals and responsive UI.
- `start.sh`, `capture.sh`: Project startup and screenshot scripts.

## Important Context
- No files have been changed.
- `GameUI` already implements screen and panel rendering, HUD updates, quest interactions, minimap, and damage numbers, but nothing instantiates it or starts the game.
- `World.update()` updates camera, projectiles, drops, and enemy AI; `World.draw()` renders the scene.
- `index.html` exposes buttons and overlays for the menu, character selection, intro, pause, death, panels, dialogue, and mobile controls.

## Objective
- Complete Eldoria as a playable dark-fantasy action RPG by connecting existing systems and adding game startup and progression.

## Requirements
- Build without clarification; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finishing.
- For visual checks, save a small JPEG screenshot with a viewport no wider than 1280px and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- No implementation decisions made yet.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected the game UI, gameplay modules, HTML, and startup scripts; confirmed gameplay orchestration and initialization are absent.
- Identified existing UI features and systems available to connect.

### Active
- Implement and connect the game loop, UI interactions, and playable progression, primarily in `src/main.js`.
- Verify the game in-browser and capture and inspect the latest small JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- None.

## Next Move
1. Add initialization, character selection, save/load, input bindings, HUD abilities, and the animation loop.
2. Connect combat, movement, inventory, quests, pause/death, and dialogue to gameplay.
3. Run and verify the game in-browser; capture and inspect the latest small JPEG screenshot.
4. Summarize completed work and briefly note assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Existing UI; missing gameplay orchestration and initialization.
- `index.html`: Menus, character selection, HUD, panels, and overlays.
- `src/world.js`: World rendering, enemies, drops, projectiles, and AI.
- `src/combat.js`: Attacks, skills, damage, loot rewards, and combat updates.
- `src/player.js`: Player creation and movement.
- `src/inventory.js`: Equipment, loot, and stat recalculation.
- `src/progression.js`: Leveling logic.
- `src/data.js`: Classes, enemies, quests, items, and regions.
- `src/save.js`: Local save/load support.
- `styles.css`: Game visuals and responsive UI.
- `start.sh`, `capture.sh`: Project startup and screenshot scripts.

## Important Context
- No files have been changed.
- `GameUI` already implements screen and panel rendering, HUD updates, quest interactions, minimap, and damage numbers, but nothing instantiates it or starts the game.
- `World.update()` updates camera, projectiles, drops, and enemy AI; `World.draw()` renders the scene.
- `index.html` exposes buttons and overlays for the menu, character selection, intro, pause, death, panels, dialogue, and mobile controls.

## Objective
- Complete Eldoria as a playable dark-fantasy action RPG by connecting existing systems and adding startup and progression.

## Requirements
- Build without clarification; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finishing.
- For visual checks, save a small JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Track kills for the current six-enemy hunt quest separately from lifetime kills so quest progress is accurate.

## Work State
### Completed
- Updated `src/main.js` to import starter gear and add `started` and `questKills` state.
- Updated quest progression to count six hunt kills independently of lifetime kills.
- Added Maera dialogue after the boss is defeated.
- Connected inventory save-button and map-panel hooks; added large-map drawing and quest progress display.

### Active
- Implement startup, game loop, UI interactions, and playable progression, primarily in `src/main.js`.
- Connect combat, movement, inventory, quests, pause/death, and dialogue.
- Verify in-browser and capture and inspect the latest small JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Implement initialization, character selection, save/load, input bindings, HUD abilities, and the animation loop.
2. Finish wiring combat, movement, inventory, quests, pause/death, and dialogue; verify referenced helpers such as `saveCurrent`.
3. Run and verify the game in-browser; capture and inspect the latest small JPEG.
4. Summarize completed work and briefly note assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: UI rendering and current orchestration changes; startup and game loop remain unfinished.
- `index.html`: Menus, character selection, HUD, panels, overlays, and mobile controls.
- `src/world.js`: World rendering, enemies, drops, projectiles, and AI updates.
- `src/combat.js`: Attacks, skills, damage, loot rewards, and combat updates.
- `src/player.js`: Player creation and movement.
- `src/inventory.js`: Equipment, loot, and stat recalculation.
- `src/progression.js`: Leveling logic.
- `src/data.js`: Classes, enemies, quests, items, and regions.
- `src/save.js`: Local save/load support.
- `styles.css`: Game visuals and responsive UI.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot capture script.
- `start.sh`: Project startup script.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; no startup, browser verification, or screenshot work has been completed.
- `GameUI` already provides screen and panel rendering, HUD updates, quest interactions, minimap, and damage numbers, but no game instance or loop currently starts the game.
- `Combat` and `Inventory` expect an initialized game object with `ui`, `world`, and related systems.

## Objective
- Complete Eldoria as a playable dark-fantasy action RPG by connecting existing systems and adding startup and progression.

## Requirements
- Build without clarification; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finishing.
- For visual checks, save a small JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Track kills for the current six-enemy hunt quest separately from lifetime kills so quest progress is accurate.

## Work State
### Completed
- Updated `src/main.js` to import `STARTER_GEAR` and add `started` and `questKills` state.
- Updated quest progression to count six hunt kills independently of lifetime kills.
- Added Maera dialogue after the boss is defeated.
- Connected inventory save-button and map-panel hooks; added large-map drawing and quest progress display.

### Active
- Implement startup, game loop, UI interactions, and playable progression, primarily in `src/main.js`.
- Connect combat, movement, inventory, quests, pause/death, and dialogue.
- Verify helper references such as `saveCurrent`; run and verify the game in-browser, then capture and inspect the latest small JPEG.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Implement initialization, character selection, save/load, input bindings, HUD abilities, and the animation loop.
2. Finish wiring combat, movement, inventory, quests, pause/death, and dialogue; verify referenced helpers such as `saveCurrent`.
3. Run and verify the game in-browser; capture and inspect the latest small JPEG.
4. Summarize completed work and briefly note assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: UI rendering and current orchestration changes; startup and game loop remain unfinished.
- `index.html`: Menus, character selection, HUD, panels, overlays, and mobile controls.
- `src/world.js`: World rendering, enemies, drops, projectiles, and AI updates.
- `src/combat.js`: Attacks, skills, damage, loot rewards, and combat updates.
- `src/player.js`: Player creation and movement.
- `src/inventory.js`: Equipment, loot, and stat recalculation.
- `src/progression.js`: Leveling logic.
- `src/data.js`: Classes, enemies, quests, items, and regions.
- `src/save.js`: Local save/load support.
- `styles.css`: Game visuals and responsive UI.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot capture script.
- `start.sh`: Project startup script.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; startup, browser verification, and screenshot inspection have not been completed.
- `GameUI` already provides screen and panel rendering, HUD updates, quest interactions, minimap, and damage numbers, but no game instance or loop currently starts the game.
- `Combat` and `Inventory` expect an initialized game object with `ui`, `world`, and related systems.

## Decisions
- Track kills for the current six-enemy hunt quest separately from lifetime kills so quest progress is accurate.

- Updated `src/main.js` with `started` and `questKills` state, hunt quest progress, Maera dialogue after the boss, and inventory/map panel hooks including map drawing and quest progress display.

## Objective
- Complete Eldoria as a playable dark-fantasy action RPG by connecting existing systems and adding startup and progression.

## Requirements
- Build without clarification; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finishing.
- For visual checks, save a small JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Track kills for the current six-enemy hunt quest separately from lifetime kills so quest progress is accurate.

## Work State
### Completed
- Updated `src/main.js` with `started` and `questKills` state, hunt quest progress, Maera dialogue after the boss, and inventory/map panel hooks including map drawing and quest progress display.
- Inspected orchestration and supporting modules; confirmed startup and a running game loop are still missing.
- Confirmed `GameUI` renders screens, panels, HUD, quests, minimap, and damage numbers, but no game instance or loop currently starts the game.
- Confirmed `saveCurrent` is referenced by the save button but is undefined.

### Active
- Implement startup, game loop, character selection, save/load, input bindings, HUD abilities, and playable progression in `src/main.js`.
- Connect combat, movement, inventory, quests, pause/death, and dialogue.
- Run and verify the game in-browser; capture and inspect the latest small JPEG.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect remaining UI and data requirements in `index.html` and `src/data.js`, then implement initialization and the animation loop.
2. Connect input, HUD, save/load, combat, movement, inventory, quests, pause/death, and dialogue; define or replace `saveCurrent`.
3. Run and verify the game in-browser; capture and inspect the latest small JPEG.
4. Summarize completed work and briefly note assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Current orchestration changes; startup and loop remain unfinished.
- `index.html`: Menus, character selection, HUD, panels, overlays, and mobile controls.
- `src/world.js`: World rendering, enemies, drops, projectiles, and AI updates.
- `src/combat.js`: Attacks, skills, damage, loot rewards, and combat updates.
- `src/player.js`: Player creation and movement.
- `src/inventory.js`: Equipment, loot, and stat recalculation.
- `src/progression.js`: Leveling logic.
- `src/data.js`: Classes, enemies, quests, items, intro lines, and starter gear.
- `src/save.js`: Local save/load support.
- `styles.css`: Game visuals and responsive UI.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot capture script.
- `start.sh`: Project startup script.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; latest known status showed only `src/main.js` modified.
- `Combat` and `Inventory` expect an initialized game object with `ui`, `world`, and related systems.
- `GameUI.openPanel()` attaches a save button handler that calls undefined `saveCurrent()`.

## Objective
- Complete Eldoria as a playable dark-fantasy action RPG by connecting existing systems and adding startup and progression.

## Requirements
- Build without clarification; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finishing.
- For visual checks, save a small JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Track kills for the current six-enemy hunt quest separately from lifetime kills so quest progress is accurate.

## Work State
### Completed
- Updated `src/main.js` with `started` and `questKills` state, hunt quest progress, Maera dialogue after the boss, and inventory/map panel hooks including map drawing and quest progress display.
- Inspected orchestration and supporting modules; confirmed startup and a running game loop are still missing.
- Confirmed `GameUI` renders screens, panels, HUD, quests, minimap, and damage numbers, but no game instance or loop currently starts the game.
- Confirmed `saveCurrent` is referenced by the save button but is undefined.
- Inspected quest data in `src/data.js`, including intro, hunt, boss, and done quests.

### Active
- Implement startup, game loop, character selection, save/load, input bindings, HUD abilities, and playable progression in `src/main.js`.
- Connect combat, movement, inventory, quests, pause/death, and dialogue.
- Run and verify the game in-browser; capture and inspect the latest small JPEG.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect remaining UI and data requirements in `index.html` and `src/data.js`, then implement initialization and the animation loop.
2. Connect input, HUD, save/load, combat, movement, inventory, quests, pause/death, and dialogue; define or replace `saveCurrent`.
3. Run and verify the game in-browser; capture and inspect the latest small JPEG.
4. Summarize completed work and briefly note assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Current orchestration changes; startup and loop remain unfinished.
- `index.html`: Menus, character selection, HUD, panels, overlays, and mobile controls.
- `src/world.js`: World rendering, enemies, drops, projectiles, and AI updates.
- `src/combat.js`: Attacks, skills, damage, loot rewards, and combat updates.
- `src/player.js`: Player creation and movement.
- `src/inventory.js`: Equipment, loot, and stat recalculation.
- `src/progression.js`: Leveling logic.
- `src/data.js`: Classes, enemies, quests, items, intro lines, and starter gear.
- `src/save.js`: Local save/load support.
- `styles.css`: Game visuals and responsive UI.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot capture script.
- `start.sh`: Project startup script.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; latest known status showed only `src/main.js` modified.
- `Combat` and `Inventory` expect an initialized game object with `ui`, `world`, and related systems.
- `GameUI.openPanel()` attaches a save button handler that calls undefined `saveCurrent()`.

## Objective
- Complete Eldoria as a playable dark-fantasy action RPG by connecting existing systems and adding startup and progression.

## Requirements
- Build without clarification; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finishing.
- For visual checks, save a small JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Track kills for the current six-enemy hunt quest separately from lifetime kills so quest progress is accurate.

## Work State
### Completed
- Updated `src/main.js` with `started` and `questKills` state, hunt quest progress, Maera dialogue after the boss, and inventory/map panel hooks including map drawing and quest progress display.
- Inspected orchestration and supporting modules; confirmed startup and a running game loop are still missing.
- Confirmed `GameUI` renders screens, panels, HUD, quests, minimap, and damage numbers, but no game instance or loop currently starts the game.
- Confirmed `saveCurrent` is referenced by the save button but is undefined.
- Inspected quest data in `src/data.js`, including intro, hunt, boss, and done quests.
- Reviewed `index.html`, `src/data.js`, `src/save.js`, `src/player.js`, `src/progression.js`, `src/combat.js`, `src/inventory.js`, and `src/world.js` to identify game lifecycle and UI requirements.

### Active
- Implement startup, game loop, character selection, save/load, input bindings, HUD abilities, and playable progression in `src/main.js`.
- Connect combat, movement, inventory, quests, pause/death, and dialogue.
- Run and verify the game in-browser; capture and inspect the latest small JPEG.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Implement initialization and animation loop in `src/main.js`, including character selection and restoring/saving game state.
2. Connect input, HUD abilities, combat, movement, inventory, quests, pause/death, and dialogue; define or replace `saveCurrent`.
3. Run and verify the game in-browser; capture and inspect the latest small JPEG.
4. Summarize completed work and briefly note assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Current orchestration changes; startup and loop remain unfinished.
- `index.html`: Menus, character selection, HUD, panels, overlays, and mobile controls.
- `src/world.js`: World rendering, enemies, drops, projectiles, and AI updates.
- `src/combat.js`: Attacks, skills, damage, loot rewards, and combat updates.
- `src/player.js`: Player creation and movement.
- `src/inventory.js`: Equipment, loot, and stat recalculation.
- `src/progression.js`: Leveling logic.
- `src/data.js`: Classes, enemies, quests, items, intro lines, and starter gear.
- `src/save.js`: Local save/load support.
- `styles.css`: Game visuals and responsive UI.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot capture script.
- `start.sh`: Project startup script.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; latest known status showed only `src/main.js` modified.
- `Combat` and `Inventory` expect an initialized game object with `ui`, `world`, and related systems.
- `GameUI.openPanel()` attaches a save button handler that calls undefined `saveCurrent()`.

## Objective
- Complete Eldoria as a playable dark-fantasy action RPG by connecting existing systems and adding startup and progression.

## Requirements
- Build without clarification; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finishing.
- For visual checks, save a small JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Track kills for the current six-enemy hunt quest separately from lifetime kills.

## Work State
### Completed
- Updated `src/main.js` with quest kill tracking, Maera dialogue after the boss, and inventory/map panel hooks, including map drawing and quest progress display.
- Inspected game modules and UI markup to identify lifecycle and interaction needs.

### Active
- Implement initialization, character selection, save/load, input bindings, HUD abilities, and the game loop in `src/main.js`.
- Connect combat, movement, inventory, quests, pause/death, and dialogue.
- Run and verify the game in-browser; capture and inspect the latest small JPEG.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Implement initialization and animation loop in `src/main.js`, including character selection and restoring/saving game state.
2. Connect input, HUD abilities, combat, movement, inventory, quests, pause/death, and dialogue; define or replace `saveCurrent`.
3. Run and verify the game in-browser; capture and inspect the latest small JPEG.
4. Summarize completed work and briefly note assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Orchestration and UI; startup and loop remain unfinished.
- `index.html`: Menus, character selection, HUD, panels, overlays, and mobile controls.
- `src/world.js`: World rendering, enemies, drops, projectiles, and AI updates.
- `src/combat.js`: Attacks, skills, damage, loot rewards, and combat updates.
- `src/player.js`: Player creation and movement.
- `src/inventory.js`: Equipment, loot, and stat recalculation.
- `src/progression.js`: Leveling logic.
- `src/data.js`: Classes, enemies, quests, items, intro lines, and starter gear.
- `src/save.js`: Local save/load support.
- `styles.css`: Game visuals and responsive UI.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot capture script.
- `start.sh`: Project startup script.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; latest known status showed only `src/main.js` modified.
- `Combat` and `Inventory` expect an initialized game object with `ui`, `world`, and related systems.
- `GameUI.openPanel()` attaches a save button handler that calls undefined `saveCurrent()`.
- `loadGame()` expects saved data containing `character` and `inventory`; `Inventory` accepts either a bag array or `{bag, equipment}`.

## Objective
- Complete Eldoria as a playable dark-fantasy action RPG by connecting existing systems and adding startup and progression.

## Requirements
- Build without clarification; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finishing.
- For visual checks, save a small JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Track kills for the current six-enemy hunt quest separately from lifetime kills.

## Work State
### Completed
- `src/main.js` has quest kill tracking, Maera dialogue after the boss, inventory/map panel hooks, map drawing, and quest progress display.
- Inspected game modules, UI markup, and lifecycle needs; `GameUI` already provides most HUD and panel rendering.

### Active
- Implement startup, character selection, save/load, input bindings, HUD abilities, and game loop in `src/main.js`.
- Connect combat, movement, inventory, quests, pause/death, and dialogue.
- Run and verify the game in-browser; capture and inspect the latest small JPEG.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Complete `src/main.js` initialization and animation loop, including character selection and restoring/saving game state.
2. Connect input, HUD abilities, combat, movement, inventory, quests, pause/death, and dialogue; define or replace `saveCurrent`.
3. Run and verify the game in-browser; capture and inspect the latest small JPEG.
4. Summarize completed work and briefly note assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Orchestration and UI; startup and loop remain unfinished.
- `index.html`: Menus, character selection, HUD, panels, overlays, and mobile controls.
- `src/world.js`: World rendering, enemies, drops, projectiles, and AI updates.
- `src/combat.js`: Attacks, skills, damage, loot rewards, and combat updates.
- `src/player.js`: Player creation and movement.
- `src/inventory.js`: Equipment, loot, and stat recalculation.
- `src/progression.js`: Leveling logic.
- `src/data.js`: Classes, enemies, quests, items, intro lines, and starter gear.
- `src/save.js`: Local save/load support.
- `styles.css`: Game visuals and responsive UI.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot capture script.
- `start.sh`: Project startup script.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; latest known status showed only `src/main.js` modified.
- `saveCurrent()` is called by the panel save button but is undefined.
- `Combat` expects initialized `game.player`, `world`, `ui`, `progression`, and `inventory`; `World` creates 16 starting enemies and provides `spawnEnemy`.
- `loadGame()` requires saved data with `character` and `inventory`; `Inventory` accepts a bag array or `{bag, equipment}`.
- `index.html` exposes menu buttons `btn-continue`, `btn-new`, character select controls, pause/death controls, dialogue, and mobile controls; HUD ability slots are styled in `styles.css`.
- Additional inspection confirmed `createPlayer(classId, name, saved)`, `movePlayer(p,input,dt,world)`, `Combat.update(dt)`, `World.update(dt)` and `World.draw(ctx,dt)` are the core loop APIs.
- New-game starter gear is in `STARTER_GEAR`; `Inventory` recalculates stats and supports `serialize()`. `saveGame` stores JSON in local storage, while `loadGame` validates character and inventory fields.

12: - Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
13: - Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
14: - Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
15: - Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
